verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a developer platform with build and submission docs, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows only static markdown docs and an llms.txt index, plus a passing mention of a 'Checkout API reference' with nothing showing it is interactive or has runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec that would back an interactive explorer.
